chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ibn Bukayr, from al-Husayn al-Shaybani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'A man from your mawali permits the wealth of the Banu Umayya and their blood, and indeed, some deposits have come to him from them.' So he said, 'Return the trusts to their owners, even if they are Magians, for that would not be the case until our Qaim from the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon him) rises, so he would permit and prohibit.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on returning deposits to the Banu Umayya according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the permissibility of Banu Umayya's wealth and blood is contingent upon the establishment of the Qaim's authority, distinguishing between general trust-keeping and specific political rulings. It underscores the Shia principle that while trusts must be returned to their owners regardless of faith, the full dissolution of their rights occurs only after the Imam's rise, a concept rooted in the concept of *Tahrim* (prohibition) being lifted by divine decree.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Al Husayn Al Shaybani, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man from those in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah is permitting the wealth of the Clan of Umayya and their blood, and there have occurred some deposits with him which are from them’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Repay the entrustments to its rightful ones even though they may be Magians, for that would not be happening until the rising of our<sup>asws</sup> Qaim<sup>asws</sup> of the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household, so he<sup>asws</sup> would be Permitting and Prohbiting’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ibn Bukayr from al-Hassan al- Shaybaniy who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘

One of your Mawaliy (followers) considers use of the properties of Amawide people lawful as well as their lives. Something that they had left with him for safe-keeping is in his possession.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘You must return trusts to the rightful people even if they are of Zoroastrian people. Such matters will happen only when the one with Divine Authority from us, Ahl al-Bayt will rise. He will decide what is lawful and what is not lawful.’”
